query:
SELECT 
    CAST(gdate_happened AS DATE) as violation_date,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gdate_paid IS NOT NULL THEN 1 END) as paid_violations,
    COUNT(CASE WHEN gdate_paid IS NULL AND status_description = 'Issued to violator but un-paid' THEN 1 END) as unpaid_violations
FROM estishraf_llm_traffic_violation
WHERE status_description IN ('Issued to violator and paid', 'Issued to violator but un-paid')
GROUP BY CAST(gdate_happened AS DATE)
ORDER BY violation_date
